podcast.body: This hit song, which reached number 2 on the Hot 100 in the summer of 1973, was famously titled after Kodak's color film development system. Its commercial success highlighted the potential for products to inspire popular music. "In 1973, Paul Simon titled a hit song Codacrome, after the color film development system used by Photography Company Codac."
